claim: Source and documentation review of microsoft/nvx at commit 03103c13cf8ed843f1a30f86d2ae29df6afb621b (license MIT), read from README.md at that commit. Repository description: "Cross-Platform Micro-VM Sandbox for Agentic Workloads". Survived the landscape-sweep-20261006-vendor facts refuter and both fit refuters (Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6-Astra); no native install, run or comparison with a winner.

documentation_excerpts.text: NVX is an ultra-light micro-VM sandbox for running untrusted workloads with hardware-enforced isolation. It is built on top of OpenVMM and runs Linux as a guest.

NVX was jointly developed by the [MSR Systems Research Group][msr-systems] and [Azure Research - Systems][azure-systems], building on research results from the [Nanvix](https://github.com/nanvix) system.
